title: Enhancing Local and Global Structure in Compressed AI Agent Memory
abstract: arXiv:2611.08341v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI agents store text as embedding vectors and compress them at scale. A compression is accepted when each item's nearest neighbors survive, but agents also consolidate, delete, and compare memories, tasks that depend on which items lie far apart. We evaluate both ends with two label-free fidelities from our prior work: the local fidelity $L$ at 10 neighbors and the global fidelity $G$ at 30 to 50 percent of the memory. At 96 bytes per passage, rescored binary codes reach an $L$ of 0.97 yet move 10.1 percent of passages to another theme; PCA with 8-bit codes, at an $L$ of 0.77, moves 1.7 percent. Rescoring leaves the stored codes, and thus $G$, unchanged. We prove that across the $G$ band, $1-\nu_k$ is at most 2 to 2.18 times the square root of the near-far rank-violation rate, and that this rate follows the distance noise of the compression (correlation 0.979). Our locality-aware quantization (LAQ) turns the bound into a hinge objective

translated_title: 增强AI智能体压缩记忆中的局部与全局结构
translated_abstract: AI智能体将文本以嵌入向量的形式存储并进行大规模压缩。当每个条目的最近邻得以保留时，该压缩即被视为可接受，但智能体还需要整合、删除和比较记忆，而这些任务依赖于哪些条目彼此相距较远。我们采用先前工作中的两种无需标签的保真度指标来评估这两个层面：在10个近邻处的局部保真度 $L$，以及在记忆规模30%至50%范围内的全局保真度 $G$。在每段文本96字节的设置下，重打分的二进制编码达到了0.97的 $L$，却使10.1%的文本段转移到了另一个主题；而使用8位编码的PCA，$L$ 为0.77，仅使1.7%的文本段主题发生转移。重打分不改变存储的编码，因此 $G$ 保持不变。我们证明，在整个 $G$ 区间内，$1-\nu_k$ 至多为近远排序违反率平方根的2至2.18倍，且该违反率遵循压缩产生的距离噪声（相关系数为0.979）。我们的局部感知量化方法（LAQ）将该理论界限转化为一个合页目标函数。
tldr: 本文提出用局部保真度 $L$ 和全局保真度 $G$ 两种无标签指标评估AI智能体压缩记忆的质量，证明全局保真度可由近远排序违反率界定，并提出局部感知量化（LAQ）方法，将理论界限转化为合页目标函数，从而在压缩中同时增强记忆的局部与全局结构。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes two label-free fidelity metrics (local $L$ and global $G$) to evaluate compressed AI agent memory, proves that global fidelity is bounded by the near-far rank-violation rate, and introduces Locality-Aware Quantization (LAQ), which converts this bound into a hinge objective to enhance both local and global structure under compression.
